description: This file defines the class 'Smarty_Internal_Method_CreateData' which implements a method for creating a data object within the Smarty templating system. It contains a single class with a method that initializes and returns a data object, and interacts with Smarty's debugging system.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_CreateData
classes.description: Class providing the createData method to generate a Smarty_Data object, associated with Smarty templates.

methods.name: createData
methods.description: Creates and returns a Smarty_Data object initialized with optional parent data and template name.
